Subject: Capacity override request for ML QA pipeline

Hi Dev / Marissa --

Quick context: Nimble Retail (Lena Ortiz) confirmed a 6-week pilot starting Apr 12. Their QA/validation team will run aggressive stress tests and a synthetic load (latency-sensitive inference + KV-cache warmup) to validate our dedicated offering. The pilot is binding for our Q2 case studies and sales motion — losing the early validation would meaningfully slow the expansion.

Ask: Can we provision a short-lived reservation or an autoscaling policy exception to guarantee a 4-GPU buffer (A100-equivalent) on the us-west-2 dedicated pool for Apr 10 — Apr 24 (two weeks overlap around early validation)? Primary requirements:
- Guaranteed 4 GPUs for jobs with low-latency SLOs (p95 < 150ms)
- Separate from existing pooled capacity so the customer's QA runs don't evict other enterprise pilots
- Allow burst to 6 GPUs if autoscale triggers during peak tests

If reservation isn't feasible, what are viable mitigations? Options I know of: temporary carveout + billing override, prioritized routing to a staging carveout, or scheduled exclusive maintenance window for the pilot. Please call out implementation time, approvals needed, and estimated monthly cost delta.

Attachments: nimble_pilot_mvp.pdf (pilot plan), SOW-draft.docx (customer SOW), cost_estimate-rough.xlsx (rough numbers).

Timeline: we need a firm answer by EOD Apr 2 to confirm with the customer. Lena is ready to sign a small commitment if we can guarantee capacity.

Thanks — Jordan

On Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 9:12 AM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick context: Nimble Retail (Lena Ortiz) confirmed a 6-week pilot starting Apr 12...

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the heads-up and the attachments. High-level thoughts from infra: we can support a temporary reservation but need to pick an implementation path. A few clarifying Qs:
1) Are the tests going to use the hosted API or a Dedicated endpoint pinned to the customer's rollout? (affects routing + cache isolation)
2) Do you expect steady 4-GPU utilization, or high burstiness where autoscale must add GPUs frequently?

Options I can move on quickly (trade-offs noted):
- Short-lived Reservation (preferred): create a two-week reservation in the us-west-2 dedicated pool, pinned to an internal "pilot" tenant. Pros: simple guarantees, isolation. Cons: needs procurement sign-off and may block capacity for other pilots.
- Priority Routing + Soft Quota: mark Nimble's traffic as priority and rely on existing autoscale to ramp. Pros: no carved capacity; Cons: riskier for strict SLOs and noisy neighbors.
- Staging Carveout + Canary Release: spin up a temporary 4-6 GPU carveout in the staging cluster (not the production dedicated pool) and route the pilot traffic there. Pros: no impact on production customers; Cons: different infra path may not mirror production perf exactly.

I can estimate infra time: reservation change + validation ~ 24-48 hours; carveout + routing ~ 48-72 hours including load testing. For the two-week window you requested (Apr 10—24), we must decide by EOD Apr 2 to have time for validation.

I'll start drafting the reservation change request if you confirm the preferred path. Also linking the internal ticket I opened: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3142

--

Thanks — quick answers inline and confirming next steps.

On Apr 1, 2027, Dev Patel wrote:
> Are the tests going to use the hosted API or a Dedicated endpoint pinned to the customer's rollout?
They will run against the Dedicated endpoint (we requested a pinned endpoint in the SOW). Cache-warmup behavior is part of the validation (so performance parity matters).

> Do you expect steady 4-GPU utilization, or high burstiness where autoscale must add GPUs frequently?
Expect medium steady utilization with occasional bursts (+2 GPUs) during long synthetic runs. Please plan for 4 guaranteed + ability to burst to 6.

Budget: Nimble committed to a small one-time pilot fee and is OK with a short reservation charge. Rough estimate: ~$3,400 for the two-week buffer (subject to final pricing from Marissa/Finance).

Business justification (for procurement):
"Nimble Retail is a strategic early adopter for our retail vertical playbook. This pilot will produce three case-study-quality benchmarks and an integration that opens additional sales channels. The buffer ensures reliable validation and prevents correlation failures that would materially delay go-to-market."

Next steps I will take now:
- Fill reservation request form and attach SOW (done).
- Share an explicit sign-off email from Nimble (Lena is CC'd and can confirm).

Marissa — if procurement approves the two-week reservation we need infra to schedule the carveout/reservation and run a brief (2-hour) perf validation on Apr 9. Dev — can you block time for a 9:00 AM run on Apr 9?

Thanks all — Jordan
